deck.name: Building a Governed Client Acquisition Function

waivers.TEXT_TOO_SMALL: DeepGrid template uses 9pt pagination and 11.5pt compact evidence-card copy; substantive titles and primary claims remain 13pt or larger and are checked in real render QA.
waivers.TEXT_LOW_CONTRAST: The linter evaluates transparent number-label text boxes against the slide surface instead of their underlying navy process cards. Contact-sheet inspection confirms cyan labels are legible on those dark cards.
waivers.LAYOUT_REPETITION: Repeated Level, context-file, role, and channel sequences intentionally use stable geometry to make comparisons faster across an analytical series.
